head: Disney Plus Hulu app merger: one app with live TV in December
dek: Disney says Hulu's last missing parts, its live TV service and some premium add-ons, move into the Disney+ app in December, giving subscribers what it calls a fully unified experience. It announced this with its quarterly earnings on 17 November.
details: Disney gave no exact date and hasn't said when, or whether, the standalone Hulu app will shut down. A Disney spokesperson told Engadget that standalone Disney+ and Hulu plans will continue. Disney added a Hulu tab to the Disney+ app in 2023, but the two have stayed separate apps until now. Also from December, Disney+ shows videos from TikTok creators under a deal reached in August.
where: Disney+ app, from December (no exact date); standalone Hulu plans continue in the US
means: If you watch Hulu, including Hulu with live TV, you'll be able to do it all inside the Disney+ app from December. Your standalone plan isn't going away, according to Disney.
todo: Nothing to do yet. If you use Hulu with live TV, look for it in the Disney+ app in December, and keep the Hulu app until Disney says what happens to it.
thumb_words: HULU MOVES INTO DISNEY+ IN DECEMBER
